input_encoding.item: name -> key and reservationId; projectId "synthetic-project"; dimension "openai.output_tokens"; created_at -> createdAt; count -> count (null when absent); final true + final_at -> finality {basis provider_terminal_known, finalAt}; bound -> bound (null when absent); truth_n1[name] -> n1

input_encoding.released_never_left: state released_never_left is encoded as its qualified finality: basis never_left_release, finalAt = created_at, count final_total 0 (R2 finality rule never_left_release => final_total 0)
input_encoding.attribution: atts[name] -> {itemKey name, observationId of the projected observation, coverage, q (null unless reflected), n1, conflict, issuerQualified true, evidenceDigest synthetic sha256}
input_encoding.observation: obs -> {id "obs", kind, value, window, asOf, freshUntil, semantics, dimension openai.output_tokens}; earlier_q -> priorQ; scope_active false -> scopeQualified false
input_encoding.registry: registry[W] -> {windowKey W, scopeId "synthetic-scope", qualRevision 1, dimension, unit, start, end, semantics, measurementBasis}
input_encoding.append: time/append vectors: candidate on registered window {start,end}, receivedAt = now, issuer scope = registration scope; delta -> ClockBound {delta, qualifiedBasis "synthetic-qualified-fixture-clock"}
input_encoding.expected_keys: snake_case expected keys map to camelCase result fields by a fixed table in the test; only keys present in a frozen expectation are asserted
